gc_guide.text: The Wales Coast Path was opened in 2012. It goes the whole way round the country, all eight hundred and some miles of it.
You can walk it in sections. People do it in a summer. People also do it in a lifetime, in bits, with a flask.

gc_student.text: Our college is in the castle. It is the most beautiful place to be homesick in.
We all learn to do the coastguard and rescue work, if you can believe it. A castle and a lifeboat. Odd, but it works.

gc_fossil.text: Stand back from the cliff and look at the rocks on the beach. Half of them have a spiral in them. That is a fossil, or a very decorative accident.
I once found an ammonite the size of a dinner plate. I was so pleased I forgot my own sandwich.
